purpose: Test individual remedies, then promote safe, useful candidates to an original-only full-corpus comparison.
timing_scope: Complete four-resource cached algorithm reads; discovery and first read reported separately. No output-value cache; every read processes current pixels.

techniques.cache: Bounded memoization of immutable scaled glyph/comma templates; no memoized reading values.
techniques.prune: Skip impossible touching-digit counts using the minimum per-cell width already required by the baseline.
techniques.green: Include a bounded green color family in value-region extraction and numeric foreground, keeping label discovery unchanged.
techniques.labels: Denser small-font scale steps, vertical RGB raster phases, and refinement of existing 0.76+ proposals with unchanged final shape thresholds.
techniques.small: Extend the small-font scale bank, scale-aware row margins, and internal nearest-neighbor numeric enlargement.
techniques.consensus: Require at least two agreeing accepted decodes among four bounded brightness thresholds, with no accepted disagreement, only after baseline numeric rejection.
techniques.topology: Replace exact hole-count exclusion with a shape-score penalty, retaining numeric acceptance and ambiguity thresholds.
techniques.partial: Allow strong visible label suffixes only after three other resource anchors establish position, scale, row order and spacing. Never infer hidden digits.

focused_tests.numeric: Identical annotated original RGB numeric crops for component diagnosis; compare values, incorrect accepts, unknowns and repeated timing. This does not establish automatic panel detection.
focused_tests.full_frame: Whole original screenshots representing each affected pattern, prior positives, closed/clipped panels and duplicate-panel ambiguity. No annotation coordinates passed to readers.
focused_tests.adversarial: Existing historical unit diagnostics for clipping, extra columns, decoy numbers, topology, ambiguity and fresh-frame invalidation; synthetic diagnostics remain separate from real acceptance.

promotion_gate.benefit: More correctly bound readable values, or equivalent outputs with meaningfully lower cached cost.
promotion_gate.latency: Measure on the same host/settings as the baseline; report violations of the working 50 ms p95 target. Accuracy-promising but slow candidates are not declared suitable for real time.

followup_after_first_focused_results.reason: Four-threshold consensus improves coverage but is costly; template caching helps, while pruning alone shows no clear timing benefit.
followup_after_first_focused_results.vector: Batch the same glyph/template score calculation; require equivalent values before considering performance.
followup_after_first_focused_results.glyph_cache: Bounded cache of glyph rankings keyed by the complete normalized glyph, aspect ratio, height, hole count, scale and family. Every frame still segments and assembles the current numeric text; no complete resource reading or output value is cached.
followup_after_first_focused_results.validation: Report first-read cost separately and use existing changed-value/fresh-frame guards. Static-repeat cache results do not establish live gameplay performance.

full_benchmark: Every one of the 51 preserved originals, with new primary, prior primary, reference-only and safety controls separated. At least 50 repeated cached reads for each discovered layout. Preserve all raw outputs outside Git history.
integrity: No annotation changes, no screenshot transformations as acceptance inputs, no per-case IDs or truth in readers, no new screenshot-derived templates. These previously diagnosed images now provide development/regression evidence, not untouched holdout generalization.

followup_after_full_round_one.evidence: The first combined reader recovers 11/26 misses; consensus recovers 15/26 but incurs 84.7 ms p95 and 147.4 ms on the slowest image. Isolated numeric gains did not predict the full pipeline latency.

hypotheses.pruning_interaction: The combined readers had not enabled the separately tested minimum-cell-width count pruning. Apply the exact existing width bound before enumerating impossible split products.
hypotheses.touching_glyph_cache: The first glyph cache accelerated separated glyphs only. Apply the same bounded vector/glyph ranking cache to repeated candidate fragments in the touching-digit fallback, preserving that fallback strict topology and every score/ambiguity threshold.

followup_after_full_round_one.focused_gate: Two slowest original frames, shared autonomously discovered layout, exact per-field output/region equality before and after acceleration; report this as cached-layout diagnosis only.
followup_after_full_round_one.promotion: If unchanged outputs and useful speedup, rerun all 51 originals with independent discovery for baseline, both previous combinations, both pruned combinations and both touching-cache combinations; 50 repeats and existing guards.
followup_after_full_round_one.not_heldout: Follow-up is explicitly selected after inspecting the first full development/regression run; no generalization claim.
